Here's a LinkedIn post for you:

---

🎉 Thrilled to announce that I've joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 

Having worked with this innovative clinical decision support standard since 2017, I've seen firsthand how CDS Hooks can transform healthcare delivery by seamlessly integrating evidence-based guidance directly into clinical workflows. I'm excited to contribute to the continued evolution and adoption of this important standard.

To the CDS Hooks community:
📍 If you're already using CDS Hooks, please help us showcase the growing ecosystem by adding your implementation to: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

💡 If you're considering CDS Hooks but haven't started yet, I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you navigate implementation and unlock the power of real-time clinical decision support in your EHR workflows.

Looking forward to collaborating with the brilliant minds on the PMC and the broader community to advance interoperable clinical decision support! 

#HealthIT #ClinicalDecisionSupport #CDSHooks #HealthcareInnovation #Interoperability #DigitalHealth

---
